Banquet Halls
Welcome to the elegant banquet halls of Hotel Deepa Comforts, where sophistication meets versatility. Our spacious, well-appointed venue is ideal for a range of events, from corporate meetings and conferences to weddings and social celebrations. With contemporary decor and state-of-the-art audiovisual equipment, the halls can accommodate a variety of setups to suit your needs. Our Hotel consists of two luxurious high capacity banquet halls
(Shehnai and Senate)
for large gatherings and three customizable medium capacity halls
(Moments, Baithak and Board Room)
to suit corporate needs. We also house a very large capacity open air terrace venue
(Sky Lounge)
for outdoor programmes. The in house catering provides delicious cuisines to the guests which makes the events, meetings and gatherings memorable. Our dedicated event planning team is committed to ensuring every detail is perfect, from custom catering options to seamless service. Whether you’re hosting an intimate gathering or a grand affair, our banquet hall offers a refined atmosphere and exceptional support to make your event memorable and successful. Experience the perfect blend of style and functionality at Hotel Deepa Comforts.
